fixed_design.seeds: Use each original row task seed; restore each saved rng_before independently for both arms. No added seed.
fixed_design.scope: Four policy continuations from two existing intermediate C11 states. Same route combination, not4 independent scenes. Baseline is re-executed for paired new continuation and resource timing, not re-labelling old tests.
fixed_design.budget_meaning: Baseline64 new iterations; candidate inherited corrected+fresh=64. Correlated inherited/adaptively chosen support, not64 independent fresh samples.
fixed_design.stopping: Stop each arm at first native hard safety terminal, native both parked, or128 steps. No padding, retries, outcome-based sampling, seed changes.
fixed_design.measurement: Single process. Per-search timers include candidate capture/guards/tail/rebuild, exclude separate debug export, IO and outer advance; separate end-to-end recording time includes them. No online-controller timing claim.
fixed_design.quality_criteria: All tasks kept. Strict descriptive joint-improvement flag needs both arms parked safely in each pair, candidate no longer model time, no smaller sampled clearance and smaller total search CPU AND wall. Not statistical/production authorization.
fixed_design.timing_limitations: Two already used fixed initial states; repeated decisions correlated, order counterbalanced but not CPU exclusive/frequency-controlled. No stable speedup or generalization theorem.
postconditions: every candidate root contribution reconstructed from saved rewards
